title: Regarding the HP fanfiction post: I don’t understand why you’re so flippant and antagonistic against people writing it. I fucking hate JKR and her anti-trans crusade. I also grew out of HP years ago and don’t engage with it at all anymore. But I understand that it can mean a lot to people, because it meant a lot to me as a kid, it was my only lifeline for many years and is probably the reason I’m still alive.
